SELECT t.id, t.orderId, t.userId, t.goodId, t.quantity, t.originAddress, t.currentAddress, t.targetAddress, t.createTime, t.payTime, t.cancelTime, t.finishTime, t.`delete`, g.userId AS merchantUserId, u.userName, g.goodsName, g.goodsPrice, (g.goodsPrice * t.quantity) AS totalPrice FROM trade t LEFT JOIN goods g ON t.goodId = g.id LEFT JOIN user u ON t.userId = u.id
t.`delete` = 0 AND g.userId = #{entity.merchantUserId} AND u.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.userName}, '%') AND g.goodsName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.goodsName}, '%') AND t.originAddress LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.originAddress}, '%') AND t.currentAddress LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.currentAddress}, '%') AND t.targetAddress LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.targetAddress}, '%') AND g.goodsPrice >= #{entity.priceMin} AND g.goodsPrice <= #{entity.priceMax} AND t.finishTime >= #{entity.finishTimeStart} AND t.finishTime <= #{entity.finishTimeEnd}

SELECT u.id, u.userName, u.avatarPath, u.email, u.`describe`, u.level, u.createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g WHERE g.userId = u.id AND g.`delete` = 0) AS goodsCount FROM user u
u.level >= 1 AND u.`delete` = 0 AND u.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.userName}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade t LEFT JOIN goods g ON t.goodId = g.id WHERE g.userId = #{merchantUserId} AND t.`delete` = 0 AND t.payTime IS NOT NULL AND t.finishTime IS NULL AND t.cancelTime IS NULL
SELECT u.userName, u.`describe`, u.level, vc.levelName FROM user u LEFT JOIN vipconfig vc ON u.level = vc.level WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.`delete` = 0
SELECT imagePath, sequence FROM background WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY sequence ASC

SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.`describe`, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.`delete`, u.userName, u.avatarPath AS merchantAvatar, u.id AS merchantId, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS inCart, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.quantity ELSE 0 END AS cartQuantity FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN address ad ON g.addressId = ad.id LEFT JOIN cart c ON c.goodId = g.id AND c.userId = #{currentUserId} WHERE g.userId = #{userId} AND g.launch = 1 AND g.`delete` = 0 ORDER BY g.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.userId, a.goodsId, a.category, a.kind, a.name, a.price, a.simpleDescription, a.features FROM ai a
AND a.userId = #{entity.userId} AND a.delete = 0
